title_candidates: Claude Opus 5 is here — test its careful second pass
Claude Opus 5 arrives for longer, more careful work
summary: Claude Opus 5 is now Anthropic's strongest Pro model and the Max default. A 15-minute document test can show whether its verification and constraint-following claims help your work.

primary_source.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
primary_source.author: Anthropic
key_facts: Claude Opus 5 launched across Anthropic's products, becoming the default model for Claude Max and the strongest option available to Claude Pro subscribers.
Anthropic kept API pricing at $5 per million input tokens and $25 per million output tokens, matching Opus 4.8.
An optional Fast mode is about 2.5 times faster and costs twice the base API rate.
Anthropic reports improvements in professional work, computer use, research, visual output, work verification, and careful iteration.
Anthropic says the model more than doubled Opus 4.8's Frontier-Bench v0.1 performance while reducing cost per task.
Anthropic says Opus 5 does not move the frontier in risky dual-use capabilities and remains behind Mythos 5 in biology and offensive cybersecurity.

quote_candidates.text: Claude Opus 5 is much stronger at verifying its work and iterating carefully until it succeeds.

supporting_sources.title: Prompting Claude Opus 5
key_facts: Anthropic recommends stating the desired response length explicitly and adjusting effort to balance quality, speed, and cost.

supporting_sources.title: Claude Opus 5 System Card
key_facts: Anthropic publishes its capability and safety evaluation details in a launch-linked system card.

prerequisites: A Claude Pro or Max account
A non-sensitive 300–800 word document or familiar topic you can independently check

steps.instruction: Open Claude, start a new chat, click the model name beside the send button, choose More models if needed, and select Opus 5. Stop if it is absent; your plan or organization may not enable it.
Paste a non-sensitive text you know well and ask: Review this text, identify the three most important issues, explain each plainly, and propose a revision without inventing missing facts.
Ask Opus 5 to check every claim against your original text, list uncertainties, and correct unsupported statements. Verify the changes yourself.
Ask it to shorten the revision by 30% while preserving every date, number, and named requirement. Compare both versions and confirm those details survived.

Optionally repeat the same task with another available model and compare factual accuracy, useful corrections, and constraint-following. Do not use either result for consequential decisions without your own review.

risk_flags: The guide uses only non-sensitive material and requires independent review before consequential use.
